description: Reindex memories that have DB records but no embeddings. This fixes data inconsistencies where memories exist but their vector embeddings are missing. Safe to run - only adds missing embeddings.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Results of reindexing memories missing embeddings
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reindexing memories that are missing vector embeddings
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: EmbeddingError: failed to generate embeddings. DatabaseError: failed to query or update memory records.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For embedding errors: verify embedding service is available. For database errors: verify state and vector storage are accessible.
